text:
Ben C: FYI during the Apr close recon I found a timing mismatch: several customer credit memos were applied after invoices were recognized, so revenue schedules show net reduction in May instead of Apr. this skews our recognized revenue for Apr.
Maya R: can you paste sample rows? Is this the late-application flow we discussed last month?
Ben C: short extract from the billing export + revrec snapshot:
```
invoice_id,memo_id,invoice_date,memo_date,amount,revrec_treatment
INV-2026-1205,CM-2026-0401,2026-04-10,2026-05-02,3500,recognized-Apr but memo posted-May
INV-2026-1212,CM-2026-0403,2026-04-18,2026-05-03,1800,recognized-Apr but memo posted-May
INV-2026-1220,CM-2026-0409,2026-04-29,2026-05-04,700,recognized-Apr but memo posted-May
```
Ben C: net $6,000 of credits hit in May which reduces May recognized revenue instead of netting against Apr. policy says memos that relate to invoices should adjust the period of the original invoice when they post within the close window.
Omar N: materiality? $6k > $5k threshold. Also affects month-over-month trending and ARR math a bit.
Maya R: what caused late application? looks like the credit memo batching job was delayed due to queue backpressure on Apr 30 and items processed on May 2. we have a backlog window flag but it wasn't enabled.
Ben C: suggested remediation: 1) for close, post a prior-period reclassification JE to reflect net credits in Apr: DR 4000-REVENUE $6,000 / CR 2100-ACCOUNTS-RECEIVABLE $6,000? wait cash/AR were already settled, better approach is a reclass between revenue and revenue-correction reserve.
Maya R: agree use reclass not touch AR/cash. proposed JE: DR 4000-REVENUE (May) $6,000 / CR 4000-REVENUE (Apr) $6,000 with memo "reclass credits to original invoice period (RR-2026-0901)". but our GL doesn't support period-to-period JE easily. accounting prefers: DR 5100-REV-ADJ-PRIOR $6,000 / CR 4000-REVENUE $6,000 and document as prior-period adjustment in May pack.
Omar N: accounting lead approves the prior-period adjustment approach. also need to update revenue schedules to show net-of-credit amounts for Apr and add footnote.
Ben C: revrec-bot can you create ticket and checklist? include batch logs, queue metrics, memo extract, and JE template.
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0901 created and assigned to @Ben C; due: 2026-05-03; required attachments: credit memo extract, billing queue logs, close pack note.
Maya R: we'll also enable backlog-window flag to force in-period application for late memos that reference an invoice within close cutoff. i'll open a PR to billing-batcher to add a guard: if memo.invoice_ref exists and memo_date <= cutoff+2 days, apply in invoice period.
Ben C: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/billing-batcher/pull/678 (will attach). posting JE as prior-period adjustment in May close once approvals attached.
Omar N: approve JE and remediation. include a one-line footnote in May schedules: "Prior-period adjustment moving customer credits to original invoice period due to delayed memo processing (RR-2026-0901)."
Maya R: i'll monitor next run and confirm memos referencing invoices are applied to invoice period when within cutoff. closing loop unless audit requests more detail. :white_check_mark:
